title: Mike Masters' theory that UFOs are time-traveling humans
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Mike Masters' theory that UFOs are time-traveling humans, about recent at Montana Tech, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's a guy named Mike Masters I don't know if you're familiar with him he's a an evolutionary biologist at Montana Tech uh University and he's written a couple of interesting books one called identified flying objects

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels describes the idea of Mike Masters, an evolutionary biologist at Montana Tech, a university in Montana. Michels says Masters has written books, including Identified Flying Objects and Extempore, arguing that UFOs may be humans from the future travelling back in time. If true, it would mean the visitors are not aliens but our own descendants.
